name: command-center
description: Read surface for the Director Swarm instrument. Every verb is a read; the CLI has no write path (CC-P0-013).

groups.name: board
groups.description: The derived board and its composed readings.

commands.name: board
commands.description: Show the derived board shape: rooms, the outcome denominator with its confidence, and per-source availability.

commands.name: room
commands.description: Show composed readings for one outcome category, each with its coverage, trust and empirical axes and its source's declared instrument state.

flags.name: samples
flags.description: Whether illustrative readings are withheld, marked, or returned plain.

groups.name: instrument
groups.description: The ranked surface and the open-loop self-report.

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Show the one ranked surface: what is worth building next, ordered, each entry naming its owner and why it ranks where it does.

flags.name: kind
flags.description: Filter to one finding kind: untrusted-reading, source-unavailable, no-instrument, no-pipeline, unregistered-outcome.

commands.name: open-loop
commands.description: Show every MISSING cell and UNREGISTERED outcome, dated and aged, including this instrument's own blind spots.

flags.name: older-than
flags.description: Only show holes that have stood longer than the given duration, e.g. 90d.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Show the full projection of this instrument's sensor space, its source bindings, and their declared instrument state.

commands.name: gaps
commands.description: Compatibility alias for open-loop, filtered to non-NOW coverage and grouped by room, matching the sensor path the outcomes charter names.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check API health and per-source dependency status.
